facts.statement: The genus Telmabates contains only one species, T. antiquus.
facts.quote: The genus contains a single species, T. antiquus

facts.statement: The species Telmabates antiquus was named and described by Howard in 1955.
facts.quote: Telmabates antiquus was named and described by Howard (1955)

facts.statement: A second species, T. howardae, was named by Cracraft in 1970 but was later moved to the new species Wunketru howardae by De Mendoza, Degrange, and Tambussi in 2024.
facts.quote: A second species, T. howardae was named by Cracraft (1970), but De Mendoza, Degrange & Tambussi (2024) moved T. howardae to the new species Wunketru howardae

facts.statement: Fossils of Telmabates were found in the Eocene Bird Clay Locality of the Sarmiento Formation in Chubut Province, Argentina.
facts.quote: from the Eocene Bird Clay Locality of the Sarmiento Formation of Chubut Province, Argentina

facts.statement: Telmabates lived between 56 and 48 million years ago during the Ypresian to Lutetian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Ypresian to Lutetian (56 to 48 million years ago)

facts.statement: Telmabates belongs to the family Presbyornithidae.

rejected.statement: Telmabates is an extinct genus of presbyornithid bird.
rejected.quote: Telmabates is an extinct genus of presbyornithid bird
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'Telmabates is an extinct genus of presbyornithid bird'

rejected.statement: Telmabates is classified as a bird (Class Aves).
